title: Engineering baseline management
description: Identify, preserve, compare, and recover coherent retained engineering states with their original governing meaning.
responsibilities: Establish identifiable baselines and expose their recorded content and governing profile.
Compare retained states and recover selected content without rewriting historical meaning.

Consume IF-007 to inspect the requested state, declared membership, original interpretation, and content gaps before composing a Baseline claim. Keep obtained material distinct from confirmed retained material and identify unconfirmed scope.
owned_state: Baseline identities, retained-state membership, and recovery/comparison selections; content custody and change authorization have separate owners.

includes: Engineering baseline establishment, inspection, comparison, and recovery.
excludes: Granting recovery permission, redefining historical semantics, or guaranteeing recovery after retained storage is destroyed.

design_limits: IF-007 now defines content and interpretation inspection from Engineering model management for SCN-019. Complete IR-003 AR derivation, content-retention confirmation, change-authority cooperation, and comparison/recovery contracts remain deferred.

Inspection success does not establish durable retention. Baseline establishment requires confirmed retention for the declared scope; partial or unavailable retention must remain unconfirmed in the reported outcome. Separately owned realization/assurance material needs its own acquisition and retention basis.
The IR-001 pilot assumes an already identifiable accessible state; this bounded Interface analysis does not implement Baseline establishment or recovery.

sources.basis: Analyst-proposed responsibility boundary derived from the existing Function landscape. Assigned Functions remain authoritative for behavior; this record describes target architecture, not observed implementation.

sources.locator: MOD-005; SCN-019, SCN-053, SCN-066 selected collaboration analysis
sources.basis: Derive consumer-focused parent contracts for selected-state inspection, adopted-REM authoring guidance, applicable action authority, and evidence applicability. Preserve child behavior/state authority, existing Function/AR allocations, and earlier contract guarantees. The selected contracts refine prior blanket deferrals; remaining retention, wider collaboration, AR, and realization gaps stay explicit. This is draft design analysis, not implemented or satisfied behavior.
